# Securitas USA

> > Securitas USA provides comprehensive security services including on-site guarding, mobile patrols, remote monitoring, and AI-powered risk intelligence solutions across industries.

Securitas is a leading security services provider offering integrated physical and electronic security solutions for healthcare, real estate, energy, and corporate clients. The company combines traditional guarding services with advanced technologies like CCTV surveillance, access control, and AI-driven risk management through partnerships with companies like IBM.

## Key Topics

- On-site guarding services
- Mobile patrol solutions
- Remote guarding and monitoring
- AI-powered security and risk intelligence
- Electronic security systems
- CCTV surveillance
- Access control systems
- Healthcare security (CHPA certified)
- Corporate risk management
- Alarm response services
- Residential security solutions
- Energy sector protection
- Security Connected: North America
- Flexible guarding models
